N1.s: Alle %lld gratisplassene er brukt. Fortsett i Cutling og lås opp, så blir denne cutlingen lagret.
N1.back: All 5 free-places-the are used. Continue in Cutling and unlock, so becomes this cutling-the saved.
N1.why: Opens like S3 with 'gratisplassene'; 'Fortsett' is the vocabulary file's continue word, so it matches the button the system shows; 'så blir … lagret' promises the save in spoken Norwegian; 94 characters.

N2.s: Alle %lld gratisplassene er brukt. Åpne Cutling og lås opp for å lagre flere.
N2.back: All 5 free-places-the are used. Open Cutling and unlock for to save more.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; here there is no continue button, so the plain 'Åpne Cutling' says where to go; 'lagre flere' needs no noun after the first sentence; 74 characters.

N3.why: 'Én plass igjen' is how Norwegians say one place left; accented 'én' as in S10; no closing full stop on a capsule, as in K1; 28 characters.

N4.why: The 'X av Y' pair from S5 and S29; 'Nå er' marks that this save is the one that fills them; 'gratisplasser' would run over 30, and N3 just named them; 26 characters.

N5.s: %lld av %lld er brukt. Lås opp og lagre
N5.back: 5 of 5 are used. Unlock and save
N5.why: Same count wording as N4 and the same 'Lås opp' as S14 and K1; 'Lås opp og lagre' tells the person one tap does both, with no pronoun hunting for its noun; numbers keep their order, so no positional forms; 33 characters.

N6.why: The button verb from S15, so the Share sheet and the unlock sheet say the same thing; 7 characters.

N7.s: Alle %lld gratisplassene er brukt. Lås opp Cutling, så blir denne cutlingen lagret.
N7.back: All 5 free-places-the are used. Unlock Cutling, so becomes this cutling-the saved.
N7.why: The N1 sentence with 'Lås opp Cutling' in place of continuing, since the form's own button unlocks; 'denne cutlingen' is the one in the form; 80 characters.

N8.s: Denne cutlingen er tatt vare på. Åpne Cutling og lås opp, så blir den lagret.
N8.back: This cutling-the is taken care of. Open Cutling and unlock, so becomes it saved.
N8.why: 'Tatt vare på' says kept safe without claiming it is saved yet, which 'lagret' would; the app speaks without a 'vi', as in the first batch; 'den' agrees with the masculine 'cutlingen'; 77 characters.
